notes.title: The FREE DLC 2018 SEASON UPDATE, is now available
notes.content:
The Free DLC 2018 SEASON update is now live, to download please follow the link on the game's store page.

Please note:-
Any saved games from before the DLC will only work and be visible if the new DLC 2018 season update is not installed.
But you will still be able to play with these saved games, by just uninstalling the DLC .

To install and uninstall the DLC, just tick and untick the "DLC Install checkbox" in the Steam Library.
New saved games created after the 2018 season update DLC is installed, will work and be visible whilst the new DLC is installed.

I hope this is helpful, and that you all continue to enjoy the game.

tags.feature: The Free DLC 2018 SEASON update is now live, to download please follow the link on the game's store page.
